# Paw-M Veterinary Clinic

> Paw-M is a boutique veterinary hospital in New Cairo, Egypt. We provide same-day diagnostics, transparent estimates and 24/7 emergency care for dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and exotic pets.

## Paw-M Main Pages

- [Home](https://pawmclinnic.com/): Boutique veterinary hospital in New Cairo — same-day diagnostics, transparent estimates and 24/7 emergency care.
- [About](https://pawmclinnic.com/about): How Paw-M works — clear diagnostics, honest estimates and medical records pet owners own.
- [Doctors](https://pawmclinnic.com/doctors): Licensed veterinarians with an average of 12 years of practice across five specialties.
- [Services](https://pawmclinnic.com/services): Full list of clinical services with pricing — checkups, vaccination, surgery, emergency, lab, dental, X-ray and ultrasound.
- [Book an Appointment](https://pawmclinnic.com/book): Online appointment booking in under a minute for dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and exotic pets.
- [Contact](https://pawmclinnic.com/contact): Clinic address, phone, email and opening hours in New Cairo.
- [Pet Store](https://pawmclinnic.com/store): Online pet supply store — food, treats, toys, grooming supplies and health accessories for dogs and cats.

## Core Services

- [General Checkup](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#checkup): Full physical exams with written wellness plans.
- [Vaccination](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#vaccination): Core and lifestyle vaccines with automatic reminders.
- [Surgery](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#surgery): Soft tissue and orthopaedic procedures in a sterile theatre.
- [Emergency Care](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#emergency): 24/7 triage with on-call critical care staff.
- [Laboratory](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#laboratory): In-house bloodwork and cytology with same-visit results.
- [Dental Care](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#dental): Scaling, polishing and extractions under monitored anaesthesia.
- [Digital X-Ray](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#xray): Low-dose digital radiography read within the same appointment.
- [Ultrasound](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#ultrasound): Abdominal and cardiac imaging by certified sonographers.
- [Nutrition](https://pawmclinnic.com/services#nutrition): Weight and diet programmes built around measurable targets.
